items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: And the band was John Smith, George Thompson, which is George Stewart. Albert Fernandez Walters on piano.

ctx.x: He's passing now too. And the band was John Smith, George Thompson, which is George Stewart. Albert Fernandez Walters on piano. And string bass, Johnny Prudoff. He was playing with that band too. And Mars Asinor on trombone.
And when you came in, you just took Wood and Joe's play, so?
